about: Mod values that are not TF2 numbers: feel settings asked for in play-tests. gen_sheets.py turns each row into a Tuning constant.

columns.why: what it does and who asked

rows.why: After hitting a wall mid-flight, for this long the speed you had before the hit comes back along the wall if you run along it or wall jump (play-test 2: momentum into a wall run should be conserved briefly)
Wall hits slower than this do not start the window
STRAFTAT slide impulse and wall/slide-jump push scaled by the drop from STRAFTAT sprint (12 m/s) to Soldier speed (5.415 m/s) (user, 2026-10-10: keep both moves, fit TF2-speed PvP)
A jump pressed this long before landing from a rocket jump still hops on landing (user, play-test 5: could not chain rocket jumps right after landing)
Sniper body shot takes half a player's health: 2 body shots or 1 headshot kill (user, 2026-10-10; no TF2 charge-up)
